prompt: Run LLM working-map straighten for as-twn-kaohsiung-shape-rect with model opus5, one pass, prescribed square must be achieved in the same pass.

transcript.note: Round 1, whole map placed in one pass from the geographic anchors. (1) Read the topology first: the LRT ring (C) is a 10-station closed cycle that geographically encircles 美麗島(8); the orange line (O) enters the ring at 哈瑪星(4) on its west flank, passes through 8 in the interior, and leaves at the crossing point 16 on its east flank before running out east to 鳳山西站(10)/大寮(12); the red line (R) enters at 凹子底(3) on the ring's north flank, passes through 8, and leaves at 凱旋(7) on the south flank before running out south to 小港(2). That gives the square its four mid-edge anchors for free: 4=west mid, 16=east mid, 3=north mid, 7=south mid, with 8 at the intersection of row(4)=row(16) and col(3)=col(7) — i.e. the ring's centre. Both trunk lines then become one straight axis each. (2) Corners assigned by walking the C cycle clockwise (its geographic orientation) 14->7->6->11->4->13->15->3->0->16->14 and giving each corner to the station that is already extremal in that quadrant: 14 凱旋武昌 (easternmost+south) = SE, 11 光榮碼頭 (southwest) = SW, 15 內惟藝術中心 (northwest) = NW, 0 高雄高工 (northeast) = NE. The two remaining stations fall on the side their geography puts them on: 6 軟體園區 on the south edge between 7 and 11, 13 鼓山 on the west edge between 4 and 15. No corner control points were needed — every corner landed on a real station. (3) Square sized to the minimum that keeps the four distinct columns (west edge / 6 / mid / east edge) and four distinct rows (south edge / mid / 13 / north edge) apart: side 3, box cols 0-3 x rows 1-4. (4) Frame chosen so that compactGridSafe is a no-op: every one of columns 0-5 and rows 0-7 carries at least one point, so no empty line can be squeezed out and the four equal sides survive compaction by construction. Row 0 is reserved for 小港(2) below the ring, rows 5-7 for 油廠國小(5)/都會公園(9)/岡山(1) above it, columns 4-5 for 鳳山西站(10)/大寮(12) east of it. (5) The three R stations north of the ring were stacked on the mid column rather than kept in their geographic east-west wobble (都會公園 sits well east of 油廠國小 and 岡山): all three are degree<=2 so the winding-order rule does not apply to them, and stacking buys three more vertical segments. (6) Winding order verified by hand at every point of degree>=3 (3, 4, 7, 8, 16) by comparing the atan2 order of the real geographic bearings against the axis directions of the placed layout; all five keep the same circular sequence.
